summary: Prudential plc furnished a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification on Form 6-K dated 14 Sep 2026, disclosing BlackRock, Inc. crossed reporting thresholds on 10 Sep 2026. BlackRock now holds 4.71% direct voting rights (117,487,042 shares) plus 2.97% via financial instruments—securities lending 2.45%, ADRs 0.08%, cash-settled CFDs 0.44%—totaling 7.68%, up from 6.86%. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated. Watch for further stake accumulation and engagement pressure on strategy, capital returns, and Asia-focused growth execution.
